rule: Flagged items are published, non-blocking, and carry their official source links. Nothing is inferred to fill a gap.

flags.title: Six 'Out' designations on the final Week-10 injury report are not corroborated by the official inactive list or the November reserve list
flags.detail: Kerby Joseph (DET), Omarr Norman-Lott (KC), Micah Parsons (GB), BJ Green II (JAX), Terrance Ferguson (LAR), Zachary Carter (AZ) carry an 'Out' game-status designation on the official injury report but appear on neither the official Week-10 inactive list nor the November 2026 reserve/injured list. All six are published blank in the corroboration columns and flagged; none is inferred.

flags.title: Week-11 injury report not yet published as of 2026-11-17
flags.detail: https://www.nfl.com/injuries/league/2026/reg11 resolves to the Week-10 report (canonical link and title both read Week 10). The latest official injury report available this session is Week 10. Week-11 designations will appear from Wednesday 2026-11-18.

flags.title: Committed Week-10 injury capture (2026-11-13) is a Friday point-in-time snapshot; final designations differ
flags.detail: The committed capture (nfl-arena/data/injuries_week10.json, captured 2026-11-13) holds 326 rows / 14 Out / 11 Questionable / 0 Doubtful. The live official report read 2026-11-17 carries the final designations: 346 rows / 70 Out / 90 Questionable / 11 Doubtful. Delta: +20 rows, +56 Out, +79 Questionable, +11 Doubtful. The 2026-11-17 read is published in this namespace; the earlier capture is retained as a dated point in the series.

flags.title: Roof/surface designation: no official field found on the pages read
flags.detail: Venues are transcribed from official pages (schedule page stadium links; game centre Game Info). No roof/surface designation field appears on the schedule or game-centre pages read this session, so roof/surface is published blank — unverified rather than inferred.

flags.title: Club depth-chart pages on nfl.com return 404 (re-confirmed 2026-11-17)
flags.detail: https://www.nfl.com/teams/baltimore-ravens/depth-chart returns the official 404 page. The depth-order source remains unresolved (requirement E13); the backup-deficiency feature must stay unbuilt until one route is verified for all 32 clubs.

flags.title: Official name-spelling variant between sources: Tyrion / Tyroin Ingram-Dawkins (MIN)
flags.detail: The injury report lists 'Tyrion Ingram-Dawkins'; the official inactive list spells 'Tyroin Ingram-Dawkins'. The join uses a surname+initial fallback for this variant; the exact-form mismatch is recorded here rather than silently resolved.
